name: bounded-document-context-execution-plan
title: Define a scalable bounded document-context architecture for 1000+ project documents
description: Create an auditable execution plan that replaces broad Markdown ingestion with thin entrypoints, live structured facts, bounded dev-memory and active playbook retrieval, task-scoped canonical document escalation, provenance/read manifests, recall-risk controls, and measurable token/quality gates. The plan must preserve authoritative decision and mechanical gate semantics while scaling to 1000+ documents.
